time_shape.evidence: length 2.10 s (1-3 s). 4 onsets at 0.011, 0.363, 0.555, 0.661 s: gaps 0.352, 0.192, 0.106 s, shrinking, strengths 1.0/0.74/0.62/0.44. spectrum.evidence: Centroid falls 1.08k/672/454 Hz (start/middle/end), energy in the 500 Hz and 1 kHz bands (-24/-23 dB at start), with a clean sparse lattice of lines up to 8 kHz. But the strongest modes sit at 416, 1044, 1678, 2092, 2725 Hz = 2, 5, 8, 10, 13 x 208.7 Hz, and YIN reports pitch 208.7 Hz, 93% voiced, harmonicity 0.94. So the main ringing is close to a harmonic series; only the upper cluster (3.55k, 3.62k, 4.15k, 5.18-5.51k) is clearly inharmonic. Partly meets 'inharmonic ringing modes'.

Waveform shows 4 distinct hits with ring tails.
